svg.text: New MODELS section in the summary popover, styled like ACTIVITY and TOKENS. Footer counts entries with no recorded model.
Jump button: closes the popover and scrolls the transcript to that model's first entry.
Single model: one row, no jump button. Answers “which model ran this tool-call-only session?”.
Change divider, drawn inside the first row of the new run (not a new list item). Never drawn for the first run.
Subagent subtitle: “Requested by” = stored source_model; “Ran on” = models attributed in the linked child session.
Child session not indexed or without any recorded model: “Subagent model unknown”.
